channel.title: OurWord AI — small, sharp tools and open research — touching the world with AI
channel.description: OurWord AI builds small, sharp, open things: a board of ideas worth building with the evidence attached, a shelf of agent skills, a falsifiable monitor of the AI build-out, a twenty-year projection of AI and work, a knowledge base of how the world actually works, a road-trip planner that re-plans itself, and a portfolio dashboard that refuses to know what you are worth. Everything is public on…

item.title: Idea
item.description: A hand-operated board of things worth building, every entry with first-hand evidence attached.

item.title: Skill Store
item.description: A daily-restocked shelf of agent skills for coding agents.

item.title: AI Bubble Monitor
item.description: Twenty falsifiable red lines on the AI build-out, checked against live numbers.

item.title: The Restructuring of Work
item.description: How AI reshapes every kind of job, 2026–2046.

item.title: Human World
item.description: 80+ figures and classic texts on how the world actually works, across 2,600 years.

item.description: A road-trip plan you can actually drive, that re-plans itself when things change.

item.title: Market Watch
item.description: Watch the shape of your portfolio, never the amount.
